extDescription.message: Filter, select, and delete files that use storage in Google Photos.

popupSubtitle.message: Open Photos to filter, select, or delete files that use storage

hideHighlightsDesc.message: Hide the highlight cards above the timeline. Files are not deleted

hideNonConsuming.message: Only show files that use storage

hideNonConsumingDesc.message: Scan in the background and hide items that do not use storage, including empty date rows

selectOccupyingDesc.message: Scan first, then select items that use storage; scrolling is locked meanwhile

deleteOccupyingDesc.message: Move files that use storage to the trash

deleteAllDesc.message: Move all files on this page to the trash

confirmDeleteAll.message: Delete all files on this page? They will be moved to the trash.

confirmDeleteOccupying.message: Delete files that use storage? They will be moved to the trash.

hintNeedPhotos.message: Open Google Photos before using this extension.

hintReady.message: Turn on “Only show files that use storage”, then select or delete.

hintRunning.message: Running. Press Stop, or use the Stop button at the bottom right.

errorTimeout.message: Timed out talking to the page. Refresh and try again

errorInTrash.message: You are in the trash, so files cannot be deleted here.
